---
title: Reveal.js structure
format:
  revealjs:
    slide-level: 2
filters:
  - veil
revealjs-plugins:
  - veil
extensions:
  veil:
    groups:
      - name: w
      - name: s
      - name: b
        shown: false
        label: 'Backup \</script> \<b>'
    state: "-mid"
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: The Reveal.js block rules and the configuration.
        check: "node veil-check.mjs"
        warnings: exhaustive
    revealjs:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        - level: WARN
          regex: "The group 'alpha' is used in the document but not declared"
          count: 1
        - level: WARN
          regex: "The group 'zeta' is used in the document but not declared"
          count: 1
        - level: WARN
          regex: "The id 'lead-wrapper' of a veiled Div is dropped, because its first header already has the id 'lead-header'"
          count: 1
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<section id="wrapped-one"[^>]*data-veil-group="w"', '<section id="wrapped-two"[^>]*data-veil-group="w"', '<div class="veil" data-veil-group="w">\s*<p>Text before the first header', '<div class="veil" data-veil-group="s">\s*<h3 id="sub-header"', '<section id="lead-header"[^>]*data-veil-group="w"', '<section id="hidden-slide"[^>]*data-veil-hidden', '<script type="application/json" id="veil-config">', '"name":\s*"w".*"name":\s*"s".*"name":\s*"b".*"name":\s*"alpha".*"name":\s*"mid".*"name":\s*"zeta"', 'Backup \\u003c/script> \\u003cb>', 'MKSUB\.</p>\s*</div>\s*</section>\s*<section[^>]*>\s*<p>After the break MKAFTERBREAK']
        - ['id="lead-wrapper"', '<hr', '<div class="veil"[^>]*>\s*<section','<section id="sub-header"', '<h3[^>]*data-veil-group', 'Backup </script>', ' group="']
---

## Plain slide

Plain text MKPLAIN.

::: {.veil group="w"}

Text before the first header MKBEFORE.

## Wrapped one {#wrapped-one}

Text MKWRAPONE.

## Wrapped two {#wrapped-two}

Text MKWRAPTWO.

:::

::: {#lead-wrapper .veil group="w"}

## Lead header {#lead-header}

Text MKLEAD.

:::

## Slide with a sub-header

Text MKSLIDE.

### Sub-header {#sub-header .veil group="s"}

Sub text MKSUB.

---

After the break MKAFTERBREAK.

## Hidden slide {#hidden-slide .veil group="b"}

Hidden text MKHIDDEN.

## Undeclared groups

[Zeta MKZETA]{.veil group="zeta"} and [Alpha MKALPHA]{.veil group="alpha"}.
